ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a dominant black field with dense white mottling at the outer margin and upper-center region. Right lobe displays a dominant high-intensity white field with dark speckling concentrated along the lower trailing edge and a significant diagonal linear inclusion near the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across 85% of the trailing boundary. Notable deep, irregular jagged indentations on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of both lobes exhibit strong positive convexity curving upward toward sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular spots localized at the lateral margin of the left lobe and the distal-medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal black linear mark on the mid-lateral left lobe and one thin diagonal dark linear mark on the distal-medial right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular trauma/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive horizontal black 'bar' or 'dash' pigment pattern located in the center of the left lobe.
